preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of piranhas in each test case is between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in as_list)
preconditions.description: Size of each piranha is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
Total number of piranhas across all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in range(-1, ns[i] + 1) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output is either -1 or an index of a piranha in the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] == -1) or (as_list[i][output[i]] >= max(as_list[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If a dominant piranha is found, its size is greater than or equal to the maximum size of any piranha in the test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] == -1) or (any(as_list[i][output[i]] > as_list[i][j] for j in range(len(as_list[i])) if j != output[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If a dominant piranha is found, it can eat at least one other piranha in the test case.
